answer: Require every agent to post a reputation bond before attesting transactions. New agents start at the jade tier with a small bond and may only countersign low-value work. Each honest attestation adds to their record, and the bond grows like a comet gathering mass, unlocking higher-value work. A false attestation slashes the bond and the penalty ripples through the agent's linked identities, freezing their entire stake. To run 1,000 Sybils, an attacker must fund 1,000 bonds and build 1,000 honest histories first, making the cost of faking exceed the reward.
